key_insight: LLM agents can translate natural-language household preferences into near-optimal home energy schedules, achieving reliable multi-appliance optimization when paired with native tool calling.
engineering_relevance: This enables a practical natural-language control layer for Home Energy Management Systems that can reduce electricity costs while handling tariffs, solar generation, weather, and appliance constraints.
method: Tool-calling ReAct agent for scheduling flexible home loads
Uses live Octopus Agile prices, weather forecasts, PV estimates, usage data, and a retrieval-augmented knowledge base
Benchmarked against MILP ground truth across tariff, conflict, and week-long deployment scenarios
evidence_signal: Across three commercial LLMs, native function calling yielded 100% scheduling success and 96.7–98.0% of oracle savings over a simulated week.
watch_item: Performance drops sharply with text-parsed action interfaces, so robust function-calling integration and constraint handling are critical for deployment.
paper_title: LLMs for Agentic Home Energy Management
